projects.title: Smart Home Automation System
projects.description: Developed comprehensive IoT-based home automation system using ESP32 and MQTT protocol. The system features remote lighting control, temperature monitoring, energy consumption tracking, and security integration via mobile application.
outcomes: Improved home security with automated alerts

projects.title: Solar Power Monitoring Dashboard
projects.description: Created real-time monitoring dashboard for solar panel installations. System tracks power generation, efficiency metrics, weather conditions, and provides predictive maintenance alerts using machine learning algorithms.
outcomes: Increased solar efficiency by 15% through optimization
Prevented 5+ major system failures through predictive alerts

projects.title: Industrial PLC Control System
projects.description: Designed and programmed PLC control system for manufacturing conveyor belt automation. Implemented advanced logic for material handling, quality control integration, and emergency stop procedures.

projects.title: Power Quality Analyzer
projects.description: Built custom power quality monitoring device using Arduino and current sensors. Device detects voltage sags, swells, harmonics, and power factor issues in electrical distribution systems with data logging capabilities.
outcomes: Identified and resolved 10+ power quality issues
Cost savings of $50,000 in prevented equipment damage

projects.title: EV Charging Station Design
projects.description: Designed complete electrical infrastructure and charging management system for electric vehicle charging station. Project includes load calculation, safety systems, payment integration, and user interface design.
